name: Hare Chane ki Sabzi
steps: Shell and rinse the green chickpeas; the measured weight is for shelled peas. Chop onion and tomato finely and mince ginger and garlic.
Heat oil and sizzle cumin. Cook onion for 7 minutes until golden, then add ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add tomato, turmeric, coriander powder, chilli powder and salt.
Cook the masala for 8 minutes until thick and glossy. Stir in chickpeas and water, cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes until a pea crushes easily between a spoon and the pan.
Uncover and reduce excess liquid until the gravy coats the peas. Stir in garam masala and chopped coriander and serve hot with separately prepared roti.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
